overview:
The target result is a deterministic fixed-tape machine that multiplies two $n$-bit integers exactly in $O(n (\lg n)^{1-\kappa})$ time, with $\kappa = 2^{-182}$. Under the model in [Fixed-tape machine model](fixed-tape-model.md), this beats the $n \log n$ growth proposed in [The n log n optimality conjecture](n-log-n-conjecture.md), so it disproves that conjecture for this model. The wiki builds the result in six parts.

The first part fixes the model and the problem, [Exact integer multiplication](exact-integer-multiplication.md). The second part develops transforms and their algebra: the [Discrete Fourier transform](discrete-fourier-transform.md), [Bluestein's chirp identity](bluestein-chirp-identity.md), [Synthetic polynomial transforms](synthetic-transforms.md), and [Radix-digit convolution](radix-digit-convolution.md), which writes integers as polynomials in a power of two. The third part covers how a tape can exchange address fields cheaply, through [Address-field interchange](address-interchange.md) and [Rank-saving recursion](rank-saving-recursion.md), built on [Linear networks and frames](linear-network-frames.md) and [Subset-intersection network](subset-intersection-network.md). The fourth part gives the [Simultaneous butterfly layer](simultaneous-butterfly-layer.md) and its fixed layout in [Transform layout](transform-layout.md), together with [Packed selected-bit addition](packed-bit-addition.md). The fifth part handles the exact arithmetic: the [Convolution over the polynomial ring](polynomial-ring-convolution.md), [Exact coefficient recovery](recovery-and-error.md), and [Carry propagation](carry-propagation.md) back to binary. The last part states the [Integer multiplication below n log n](main-theorem.md) theorem and checks that every cost term fits its bound.

parts.title: The model and the conjecture
parts.intro: This part fixes the machine model and the problem being solved. The reader needs the [Fixed-tape machine model](fixed-tape-model.md) to know what counts as a step, and the [Exact integer multiplication](exact-integer-multiplication.md) problem to know what must be output. The [n log n optimality conjecture](n-log-n-conjecture.md) is the claim the result refutes.

parts.title: Transforms and convolution
parts.intro: This part builds the transform machinery that the rest of the wiki uses for fast convolution. It starts from the [Discrete Fourier transform](discrete-fourier-transform.md) and extends it to [Synthetic polynomial transforms](synthetic-transforms.md) and to the [Polynomial ring modulo $y^r + 1$](polynomial-ring-mod-yr-plus-1.md). The [Radix-digit convolution](radix-digit-convolution.md) and [Gaussian resampling](gaussian-resampling.md) then connect these transforms to integer multiplication.

parts.title: Address moves on the tape
parts.intro: This part explains how a fixed-tape machine can exchange two address fields of an array at a cost that grows sublinearly in the field width. The [Linear networks and frames](linear-network-frames.md) and [Subspace labels](subspace-labels.md) supply the algebra, and the [Subset-intersection network](subset-intersection-network.md) realises the exchange. The [Address-field interchange](address-interchange.md) and [Rank-saving recursion](rank-saving-recursion.md) give its cost, which later parts rely on.

parts.title: Simultaneous butterfly layers
parts.intro: This part gives the main cost step: a butterfly layer applied to several selected address bits at once. The [Complex phase network](complex-phase-network.md) provides the frame changes, and the [Simultaneous butterfly layer](simultaneous-butterfly-layer.md) applies them in one pass. The [Transform layout](transform-layout.md) places the selected bits so that each transform round can use this layer, and [Guard-width bound](guard-width-bound.md) controls the precision it needs.

parts.title: Exact convolution and recovery
parts.intro: This part assembles the full exact convolution from the earlier transforms and layouts. The [Signed coefficient packing](signed-packing.md) and the [Chinese-remainder map](chinese-remainder-map.md), with [Prime source lengths](prime-source-lengths.md), set up the transform lengths. The [Convolution over the polynomial ring](polynomial-ring-convolution.md), [Phase twist](phase-twist.md), and [Exact coefficient recovery](recovery-and-error.md) show that rounding returns the true coefficients, and [Carry propagation](carry-propagation.md) turns them into binary.

parts.title: The cost bound
parts.intro: This final part checks that the whole construction meets the claimed bound. It combines the layers, interchanges, and convolution from the earlier parts into one cost table. The [Integer multiplication below n log n](main-theorem.md) page states the theorem and shows that a compatible choice of parameters makes every term fit $O(n(\lg n)^{1-\kappa})$.
